caption:
Ever heard "zip up" in Pilates and quietly wondered what it means? Momo did too. Cues are shortcuts, and plain English helps them land.

"Zip up" is a gentle lower tummy hug, about a third of your effort, like doing up snug jeans, with no breath holding. "Soften your ribs" means breathing out as your arms go overhead so the ribs settle. "Grow tall" lifts the crown of your head, not your chin. "Shoulders away from your ears" is a light suggestion, not a hard pull down.

If a cue doesn't click, ask. A different image or a quick demo often helps. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio explains the why behind each move. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
